card: Analyze the attached individual game-art cards using the attached category example sheets. The first N images correspond in order to context.cards; the remaining images correspond in order to context.categoryImages. Return one entry per requested card ID. Use these sheets and the canonical definitions. Return its category and independent abstract visual facets: support, rear backdrop, pattern geometry, depth, context density, camera, scale, subjectPosition, backgroundColor, character count. Use controlled IDs from the schema, not subject names as pattern tags. Subject/material specifics belong only in prose and materials fields. Distinguish supporting surface from environmental scenery and from surface continuation. Category 5 is a simple narrative with 1–2 characters, not every animal pair; the Gardens swan pond is category 4. Do not infer category from star count. Ignore screenshot labels and frames. Cite actual category-image IDs in exemplarIds. Provide Russian prose. For any recognizable setting (including category 4 with surface-continuation, or a simple architectural corner), fill environmentKind, backgroundLayout, backgroundDetail and backgroundProps in facets and the environment observation. environment.majorShapes lists broad scene planes/masses; secondaryObjects lists only independent rear objects or coherent object groups; smallDetails records actual grass, leaves, stones, windows, bubbles or other small accents, including absence. layout describes positions, empty space and hierarchy in Russian. backgroundProps counts secondaryObjects groups: none=0, one-or-two=1–2, several=3+. Do not count sky, clouds, ground/water planes or merged vegetation as props; do not count main-subject parts or its functional companions as rear props. backgroundDetail: broad-masses=large simple forms/material divisions; local-accents=limited small accents; repeated-detail=repeated small leaves/windows/props across substantial background areas. Observe exceptions honestly; do not relabel a detailed city or garden as empty. For graphic/plain backdrops without a recognizable place omit these optional fields. Keep support, rear backdrop and environmental detail independent. A bumper car on a floor with graphic rings behind is not an environmental rear background; a football on a marked field remains environmental category 4. Do not change category merely to match the desired calm-background generation policy. Context: {{context}}

Return ten semantic roles in slot order and Russian prose.
